items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well Tommy Flanagan was playing piano for quite a while. ... So I talked Tommy Flanagan into coming along with me.

ctx.x: Yeah trombone and vibes cause the first night I started Hank was playing the piano and the next night somebody else was there! And he’s playing all these tunes and I said
“I’ll just play with Tyree I don’t know what these guys are doing” Then Tommy Flanagan and it started to get a little tighter and Tommy Potter was playing bass.
